title: orphan-queue race: killed child can become a zombie
author: criemen
body_preview: **Version** 1.54.1  **Platform** macOS 27.2 (arm64)  **Description** When dropping a child process with `kill_on_drop`, there is a race in the orphan queue in the tokio runtime that can mean that sometimes, killed child processes will be left behind as zombies for a while, instead of being reaped.
